description.value: WOODS on Pender is a luxury glamping resort set on 7.3 wooded acres of Pender Island, offering three distinct accommodation styles: vintage Airstreams, rustic cabins, and motel rooms. Completely revitalized in 2015 from the former Inn on Pender Island, the property pairs a modern camp aesthetic with on-site dining, a CAMP Store, and a Nordic Spa. It is reached via BC Ferries to Otter Bay Terminal, roughly a 10-minute ride from the property, making it a natural destination stay on a Gulf Islands cycling tour.

address.value: 4709 Canal Road, Pender Island, B.C., V0N 2M1
